summary.headline: Astrology of Thieves and Runaways
summary.text: Astrological rules for identifying thieves, theft circumstances, the location of lost objects, and whether stolen goods will be recovered, using the Sun, Moon, Mercury, benefics, malefics, ascendant, midheaven, and house positions. Begins Timaeus Praxidus’s section on runaways and thieves, with examples involving Jupiter, Venus, the Sun, and Mercury and stolen vessels, sacred images, gold, silver, and bronze.
